name: JIANT FM
intro: A six-track groovebox (T4 is drums); it starts empty and nothing is kept at power-off unless you save it into a section.

rows.what: Back to HOME: one creature per track.
Pick the track (T1-T4; T5-T6 need TRACKS 6).
Scroll the pages of the section you are in.
Jump through any page button's pages.
In dialogs and action pages: YES / do it.
In dialogs and action pages: NO / back.
Open the MENU; tap HOME closes it.
Browse sounds of every engine, then your user presets.
KNOB 1-4 on HOME: the sound's four main controls.
Keyboard octave down / up (-3 to +3).
Both together: octave back to 0.
Start / stop.
Restart from the top without stopping.
Change the tempo (GLO + F4: tap tempo).
Mute T1 (black keys 1-6 = T1-T6).
Solo T1 while held (F3-D4 = T1-T6).
Unmute everything.
Roll a new variation; OCT+ keeps it, OCT- reverts.
The engine's own pages (tap again: next page).
INIT: back to the engine's factory sound.
RECALL: the sound as the section stored it.
Envelope pages.
Macros M1-M4 on KNOB 1-4; tap LFO to unlatch.
Make C the song's root (any key works).
GEN song generator: KNOB 1 genre, OCT+ makes a song.
Sequencer; tap again for the next set of knobs.
Zoom PATTERN / BAR / STEP.
Arm the track and record live (overdub).
Dice the sequence; OCT+ keeps, OCT- reverts.
Clear the selected track's steps, no dialog.
Metronome click: OFF / REC / ON.
Clear all sequences (asks first).
Punch-in effects while held (white keys F3-F5).
FILTER; KNOB 2 CRUSH, 3 THROW, 4 DEPTH.
Mute T1 while held (black keys 1-6).
Let go untouched: FX layer stays open; tap FX to close.
Dice the effects; OCT+ keeps, OCT- reverts.
FX pages; SELECT zooms TRACK / BUSES / EFFECT.
Stopped: save the sound as a user preset.
Left one detent: PROJECT, the four sections A-D.
On PROJECT, stopped: pick section, arm SAVE, then name and OCT+.
On PROJECT: LOAD the picked section.
Play section A on the next bar (F3-B3 = A-D).
Store into section A while playing (C4-F4 = A-D).
MENU > SYSTEM > RESTORE LAST ON: reopen last session.
UNDO the last big change (again: redo).
HARDWARE CALIBRATION: teach each button and knob.
5 seconds: update mode (let go to cancel).

tips: Power-on starts at zero: T1 ANALOG, T2 FM6, T3 LOFI, T4 DRUM, empty sequences.
Saving and loading need the transport stopped (STOP TO SAVE).
SAVE-layer stores go to flash only when you stop: stop before switching off.
On a DRUM track OCT changes how keys play: up = ratchets, down = short / ghost / flam.
Only T1-T4 play by default; GLO > SYSTEM > TRACKS 6 wakes T5 and T6.
checked: Button labels: panel.c B_NAME (SCL is the printed SEL, same position) and E_NAME.

ui_input.c main input pass: ALGORITHM track_select (trk_live), PRESETS presets_turn (preset_step on HOME), SELECT page_scroll / HOME opens GEN (confirm CF_DICE_ALL, gen_open), button+SELECT dice (EDIT/SEQ/LFO/FX) and page_jump with PRESETS, GLO+SELECT tempo, PLAY transport, SEQ+REC CF_CLEAR_ALL, OCT- / OCT+ octave -3..+3 and both = 0, HOME tap go_home / hold menu, dice OK/CANCEL via OCT+/OCT-.
ui_input.c rec_tap: REC arms the selected track and starts transport (step recording on STEP when stopped).

ui_layer.c layer_key: GLO black 1-6 mute, white F3-D4 solo, E4 unmute all, F4 tap, G4 undo; EDIT F3 INIT, G3 RECALL; SCL key = root; REC F3 clear, G3 click; SAVE song_key F3-B3 play A-D, C4-F4 store A-D; layer_oct SAVE+OCT+/OCT- store/recall; layer_play GLO+PLAY restart; FX lock (fx_lock) and FX knobs FILTER CRUSH THROW DEPTH.
seq.c perf_key: FX white keys F3..F5 effects, G5 clears lane, black 1-6 mutes; perform.c enum of effects.
ui.c open_family FAM_SAVE: SAVE from elsewhere opens SOUND/USER with SAVE armed; SV_SET levels LIBRARY/PROJECT/SOUND; params.c PROJECT page knobs {-, SLOT, LOAD, SAVE}.

ui.c PREF_RESTORE_ON (RESTORE LAST OFF by default), project.c autosave only with RESTORE LAST ON; main.c power-on init (TRK_DEF engines in engines.c, empty sequencers), panel_setup with OCT-+OCT+ at power-on, UBOOT countdown OCT-+OCT+ 5 s.
ui.c home_param: HOME KNOB 1-4 = engine knob[0..3]; ui.c trk_live default 4; gen.c GEN_LBL GENRE on KNOB 1.
docs/MANUAL.md and docs/cheatsheet-controls.png at c524e3c read for orientation.
unsure: Whether the printed SEL button label matches JIANT's SCL exactly on every FM-1 batch (firmware calls it SCL; position matches SEL).
MIDI details (ROUTE CH1-6, CLOCK INT/USB/TRS, MIDI OUT KEYS default) seen in params.c / menu_items.c but left out to keep the sheet short.
GEN's exact page-2 controls (DRUMS/BASS/CHORDS/ARP) not exercised beyond the label table.
The author notes the firmware is little tested on real FM-1 hardware (beta).
